parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with `-` for DESC. Allowed: id, event_code, unique_id, message_id, processing_status, processing_attempts, payload_date, created_at, processing_completed_at.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Search across event_code, unique_id, message_id, processing_error.

parameters.name: filter[event_code]
parameters.description: Filter to a single TMC event code.

parameters.name: filter[processing_status]
parameters.description: Filter by processing status: pending, processing, processed, failed.

parameters.name: filter[unique_id]
parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the unique_id extracted from the payload.

parameters.name: filter[message_id]
parameters.description: Exact-match filter on Temu's message id.

parameters.name: filter[created_at_from]
parameters.description: Filter events created on/after this date.

parameters.name: filter[created_at_to]
parameters.description: Filter events created on/before this date.
